## Goal
- Complete end-to-end repair, validation, canonical reconciliation, deployment, and production certification for `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.

## Constraints & Preferences
- User requires direct line-by-line completion without jumping between unrelated tasks.
- Use only canonical repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.
- Diagnose GitHub `401` before changing authentication; use approved owner/GitHub App credentials with minimum permissions.
- Never expose credentials, OTPs, passwords, bearer tokens, service-role keys, or personal identities.
- Preserve local code; do not reset, overwrite, or delete approved work without explicit authorization.
- Create recovery branch and backup tag before canonical-history reconciliation.
- Do not deploy until OTP plaintext persistence is eliminated and focused OTP tests pass.
- Do not certify production without independently verifiable SHA-matched GitHub, Actions, Render, and live evidence.
- Final acceptance requires `GitHub HEAD = Actions source SHA = Render deployed SHA = live /version SHA`.
- If proof remains unavailable, final output must start `PRODUCTION NOT YET VERIFIED` and contain only missing proof, blocker, required owner action, and next step.

## Progress
### Done
- Rechecked live endpoints:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/health → 200
  https://api.ivxholding.com/version → 200
  ```
- Live deployment still reports:
  ```text
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  commitShort=012bb088
  ```
- Rechecked configured GitHub authentication:
  ```text
  GET https://api.github.com/user → HTTP 401
  ```
- `gh` CLI remains unavailable:
  ```text
  sh: 1: gh: not found
  ```
- Root dependencies restored:
  ```text
  bun install --frozen-lockfile
  261 packages installed
  ```
- Local OTP hardening was applied in `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts`:
  - Deployment marker changed to:
    ```ts
    'ivx-member-verification-v4-secure-persistence'
    ```
  - Added `RESEND_COOLDOWN_MS = 60_000`.
  - Filesystem persistence fallback is blocked when:
    ```ts
    process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
    ```
  - Production without durable storage now throws:
    ```text
    Secure verification storage is unavailable.
    ```
  - Added `pruneExpiredCodes()` to remove verified/expired fallback records.
  - Resend flow now prunes before storage, enforces cooldown, and retains resend cap.
  - Removed user IDs, verification type, code-storage detail, and primary-store exception detail from OTP logs.
- Targeted backend tests were invoked:
  ```text
  bun test backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts
  ```
  - Output was truncated before final totals.
- `functions.runChecks` confirmed no registered Expo/React Native app at workspace root:
  ```text
  runChecks has no app to check — this workspace has no React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Web, Supabase, or Cloudflare app yet.
  ```
- Began fixing arbitrary-user OTP endpoint behavior in `backend/api/ivx-members.ts`:
  - Added a `requireAuthenticatedMember(request)` helper intended to validate bearer tokens through:
    ```ts
    client.auth.getUser(token)
    ```
  - Began changing email/phone send and verify handlers to derive user ID from authenticated session rather than request body.

### In Progress
- Complete and correct the partial authentication-binding repair in `backend/api/ivx-members.ts`.
- Replace residual `getAuthUserId(request)` uses or restore a safe helper where appropriate.
- Add focused OTP/member endpoint tests:
  - invalid/missing bearer rejection;
  - body `userId` cannot act on another account;
  - hash-only storage;
  - expiry, single-use, bounded attempts/resends;
  - cooldown, cleanup, redaction;
  - production durable-store failure behavior.
- Rerun TypeScript and targeted suites after the endpoint repair.
- Audit primary AI configuration/provider selection, timeout/retry behavior, persistence, and safe telemetry.
- Inventory local commits and uncommitted changes before any recovery branch/tag or reconciliation operation.

### Blocked
- Current TypeScript check fails because the partial endpoint refactor removed `getAuthUserId` while four non-OTP handlers still reference it:
  ```text
  backend/api/ivx-members.ts(382,52): error TS2304: Cannot find name 'getAuthUserId'.
  backend/api/ivx-members.ts(409,43): error TS2304: Cannot find name 'getAuthUserId'.
  backend/api/ivx-members.ts(442,52): error TS2304: Cannot find name 'getAuthUserId'.
  backend/api/ivx-members.ts(502,43): error TS2304: Cannot find name 'getAuthUserId'.
  ```
- Canonical GitHub authentication remains unavailable:
  ```text
  GET https://api.github.com/user → HTTP 401
  ```
- Canonical repository identity, commits, pull requests, Actions, workflow/job results, branch protection, and required review cannot be verified.
- Current `origin` is a Rork router rather than direct canonical GitHub:
  ```text
  https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```
- Render API credential/service evidence remains unavailable:
  ```text
  GET https://api.render.com/v1/services/srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0 → 400
  ```
- No approved authenticated member or owner production session is available for registration, OTP, sign-in/reset/session, owner-route, or Supabase-record verification.
- Live SHA `012bb088...` is not proven to contain local OTP and registration changes.
- Mobile/web E2E, Android emulator, iOS approved-environment tests, release builds, and SHA-matched installation proof remain unexecuted.
- OTP schema comments still identify missing production prerequisites:
  ```text
  schema repair requires the service-role key, which is not configured
  ```

## Key Decisions
- Finish the current OTP/authentication repair and make TypeScript green before starting AI, Git, Render, or release work.
- OTP verification endpoints must bind actions to the cryptographically verified bearer-token user, not request-body `userId`.
- Do not retain filesystem OTP persistence as a production fallback; require durable configured storage or fail closed.
- Treat `/health` and `/version` as proof only of deployed SHA `012bb088...`, not GitHub/CI/Render provenance.
- Preserve top-level and nested checkout state until canonical access is restored and recovery artifacts are created.
- Do not certify public chat while production returns:
  ```json
  {"source":"fallback"}
  ```

## Next Steps
- 1. Inspect the four residual `getAuthUserId(request)` call sites at lines `382`, `409`, `442`, and `502` in `backend/api/ivx-members.ts`; convert each to `await requireAuthenticatedMember(request)` with correct async status handling.
- 2. Confirm all four OTP handlers exclusively use authenticated token identity and ignore body-supplied `userId`.
- 3. Run:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit
  bun test backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts
  ```
- 4. Add and run focused member-verification/OTP endpoint security tests.
- 5. Run root/backend and Expo lint/type/test checks; capture each failure, repair, and rerun result.
- 6. Restore canonical GitHub access through approved secure owner/App flow; verify `ibb142`, canonical repository metadata, default branch, canonical HEAD, PRs, Actions, and jobs.
- 7. Create recovery branch and backup tag, safely reconcile approved changes with canonical `main`, commit, push, review, and merge.
- 8. Verify full CI on the merged SHA only.
- 9. Bind/verify Render, deploy the exact merged SHA, and prove `/health`/`/version` parity.
- 10. Execute authorized production member/owner/AI-primary and platform release certification on the final SHA.
